title: Can a Democrat Beat Darline Graham? 5 Takeaways From the South Carolina Senate Debate
summary: Dr. Annie Andrews, the Democratic challenger, accused Senator Darline Graham of taking her cues from President Trump. Ms. Graham said Dr. Andrews wouldn’t say no to socialists.
